name: Trips - Right - 30 Smash

QB.rule: Open right and hand to the tailback as he comes inside from the trips, then fake the boot left.

TB.rule: Come inside off the bunch, take the handoff downhill between the center and the right guard. Do not bounce it.

coaching_points: The tailback starts in the trips and comes all the way inside to the A-gap.
If he bounces back toward the bunch, the play is dead.
